en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, and Muhammad Bin Khalid Al Barqy, from Al Qasim Bin Urwat, from Abdul Hameed, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Mut’a. Heasws said: ‘She is not from the four (allowable wives) because she is not divorced, and does not inherit. But rather, she is only hired’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqiy from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah from ‘Abd al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) is not of four because it has no divorce or inheritance; she is only hired.’”
